correctness.rationale: Replayed inputs/artifacts/verify.py at --half-nblocks=300: VERIFY_OK. Independently verified: 204 total primitive chi (99 even, 105 odd); completeness sum_{d|q}Nprim+1=phi(q) for all q<=32; conductor==q for all 204 (proper divisor test, 0 fails); L(1) box max width ~8e-79 (<=1e-6); min |L|^2 ordering q19 i=4/12 (0.17072881600020...) < runner-up q5 i=1 (0.18525185646175...) with gap ~0.0145; L(1) formulas spot-checked against direct Dirichlet series (even matches to 1e-10, odd to truncation O(q/N)); |L|^2 lower-bound corner logic correct conditional on box not containing origin. Central even nonvanishing passes numerically (min lo/t~5.44, margin/t~4.44 at B=1500; doubled-U check passes). BUT essential inference fails: DRAFT/verify.py claim Emax=max_b|C_b| <= floor(phi(q)/2) with justification 'at most phi(q)/2 nonzero summands of modulus 1'. That justification is false: e.g. q=5, b=3 has 3 coprime residues 1,2,3 (3 nonzero summands > phi/2=2). The verifier assumes Emax=phi//2 without any rigorous per-character certificate of max|C_b|. Hence the as-presented tail majorant U=Emax/sqrt(N+1) lacks a valid proof. The conclusion is salvageable: the trivial bound Emax=phi(q) (|C_b| <= count of coprime a<=b <= phi) is rigorously valid and still yields lo-U_phi>0 for all 99 even chi at B=1500 with min margin 0.162 (checked). Telescoping sum_r(f(N+rq+1)-f(N+rq+q))<=f(N+1) via disjoint integral spans is correct; M=0 for primitive conductor>=3 is classical and numerically re-asserted. L(1) census and minimum disjointness are sound conditional on mpmath iv outward rounding (stated limitation, margins enormous). Because one load-bearing constant has a false proof, correctness FAILs pending a bounded fix.

LMFDB Completeness confirms >20M L-functions including all primitive Dirichlet L with N<=2800 with explicit precision bounds for zeros/rank, but publishes no closed interval-certified L(1) minimum table with extremal witness over q<=32. Platt mcom/3198 is rigorous zero-isolation method precedent, not L(1) enclosures/minimum. Iwaniec-Kowalski coll/053 gives AFE and Siegel-Tatuzawa-type general bounds, not a finite closed enclosure. No prior source records or mechanically implies the exact target: 204 width<=1e-6 L(1) boxes excluding 0 with named q=19 conjugate-pair minimum (chi(2)=exp(2pi i*5/18), exp(2pi i*13/18)) disjoint below all others plus 99 certified nonzero even L(1/2) enclosures recomputed from character sums with remainder bounds and orthogonality cross-check. Formulas are honestly claimed classical; novelty is the closed replayable census + disjointness witness, not database rounding.

value.rationale: Strongest headline claim judged separately: exact interval-certified minimum of |L(1,chi)| over the complete initial primitive window q<=32 (named q=19 conjugate pair, gap ~0.0145 in |.|^2) plus certified nonzero even central values. Object (primitive Dirichlet L, q<=32) and invariant (extremal size/nonvanishing feeding class-number-formula lower bounds, Siegel-zero repulsion, uniformity tests) were motivated before computation; scope is the complete initial window with every character included, no cherry-picking; value (0.40032619437...+i0.10231204279..., |L|^2 in [0.17072881600020...], runner-up 0.18525..., central minimum [0.208658,0.254844] at q=5) was not known or mechanically implied (floats only in LMFDB, general bounds in textbooks); future researcher could reasonably need the precise fact for formula checks, explicit-bound verification, benchmarking rigorous L-software. Per value guidance this is an eligible exact invariant of a natural object, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny tweak, or unexplained enumeration. Certification/replayability strengthen but do not create the claim. PASS.

residual_risks: Containment/width soundness inherits mpmath iv outward-rounding correctness at 50-80 dps (stated limitation, not independently IEEE-audited); mitigated by enormous margins (1e-2 gaps vs 1e-79 widths for L(1); >=1e-1 margins vs 1e-30 noise for central with phi bound) and published endpoints re-checkable in Arb/MPFI.
Orthogonality cross-check is float (tol 1e-6), not interval; it is not load-bearing for enclosure soundness (completeness identity + conductor filter carry enumeration).
Originality search was reasonable but cannot prove nonexistence of an obscure certified table; nearest priors compared substantively.
Central S-box widths at B=1500 are O(1e-2), not <=1e-6; only lower bound lo-U>0 is claimed, which is the correct nonvanishing witness.
